! ===========================================================================
! CISCO IOS CONFIGURATION: CORE / DISTRIBUTION MULTILAYER SWITCH
! Scenario: Profile 2: Metro MAN (FinTech & Data Center)
! Hostname: METRO-MAN-CORE-SW01
! Generated automatically by NetArchitect Recommendation Engine
! ===========================================================================
enable
configure terminal
hostname METRO-MAN-CORE-SW01
no ip domain-lookup
service password-encryption
ip routing

! --- VTP DOMAIN HARDENING ---
vtp mode transparent

! --- 802.1Q VLAN DATABASE DEFINITIONS ---
vlan 110
 name HQ_Corporate_Financial_Staff
 exit
vlan 120
 name ColoA_High_Frequency_Trading
 exit
vlan 130
 name ColoB_Clearing_Risk_Analytics
 exit
vlan 199
 name Out_of_Band_Management_OOB
 exit
vlan 200
 name EVPL_Point_to_Point_Transit
 exit
vlan 999
 name QUARANTINE_NATIVE_VLAN
 state suspend
 exit

! --- SPANNING TREE PROTOCOL (IEEE 802.1w RAPID PVST+) ---
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst
spanning-tree vlan 110,120,130,199,200 priority 4096
spanning-tree portfast default
spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default

! --- HARDENED 802.1Q TRUNK UPLINKS (DTP DISABLED) ---
interface range GigabitEthernet0/1 - 2
 description UPLINK-TO-ACCESS-SWITCHES
 switchport trunk encapsulation dot1q
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport nonegotiate
 switchport trunk native vlan 999
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 110,120,130,199,200
 spanning-tree guard root
 no shutdown
 exit

! --- SWITCHED VIRTUAL INTERFACES (SVIs) & GATEWAYS ---
interface Vlan110
 description SVI-GATEWAY-FOR-HQ_Corporate_Financial_Staff
 ip address 172.16.0.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
 exit
interface Vlan120
 description SVI-GATEWAY-FOR-ColoA_High_Frequency_Trading
 ip address 172.16.1.1 255.255.255.128
 no shutdown
 exit
interface Vlan130
 description SVI-GATEWAY-FOR-ColoB_Clearing_Risk_Analytics
 ip address 172.16.1.129 255.255.255.128
 no shutdown
 exit
interface Vlan199
 description SVI-GATEWAY-FOR-Out_of_Band_Management_OOB
 ip address 172.16.2.1 255.255.255.224
 no shutdown
 exit
interface Vlan200
 description SVI-GATEWAY-FOR-EVPL_Point_to_Point_Transit
 ip address 172.16.2.33 255.255.255.224
 no shutdown
 exit

! --- DYNAMIC ROUTING CONFIGURATION ---
router ospf 1
 router-id 172.16.0.1
 passive-interface default
 no passive-interface Vlan110
 no passive-interface Vlan120
 no passive-interface Vlan130
 no passive-interface Vlan199
 no passive-interface Vlan200
 network 172.16.0.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 172.16.1.0 0.0.0.127 area 0
 network 172.16.1.128 0.0.0.127 area 0
 network 172.16.2.0 0.0.0.31 area 0
 network 172.16.2.32 0.0.0.31 area 0
 exit

end
write memory

hostname METRO-MAN-ACCESS-SW01
no ip domain-lookup

 name HQ_Corporate_Financial_Staff
 exit
vlan 120
 name ColoA_High_Frequency_Trading
 exit

 name ColoB_Clearing_Risk_Analytics
 exit
vlan 199
 name Out_of_Band_Management_OOB
 exit
vlan 200
 name EVPL_Point_to_Point_Transit
 exit
vlan 999
 name QUARANTINE_NATIVE_VLAN
 state suspend
 exit

! --- RAPID SPANNING TREE ---
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst

! --- HARDENED TRUNK TO CORE SWITCH ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description UPLINK-TO-CORE-DISTRIBUTION-SWITCH
 switchport trunk encapsulation dot1q
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport nonegotiate
 switchport trunk native vlan 999
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 110,120,130,199,200
 no shutdown
 exit

! --- ACCESS EDGE PORTS (WITH PORTFAST & BPDU GUARD) ---

! ===========================================================================
! CISCO IOS CONFIGURATION: ENTERPRISE BORDER / CORE ROUTER
! Scenario: Profile 2: Metro MAN (FinTech & Data Center)
! Hostname: METRO-MAN-BORDER-ROUTER01
! Generated automatically by NetArchitect Recommendation Engine
! ===========================================================================
enable
configure terminal
hostname METRO-MAN-BORDER-ROUTER01
no ip domain-lookup
service password-encryption

! --- INTERFACE CONFIGURATION ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 description LAN-INTERNAL-CORE-LINK
 ip address 172.16.0.254 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
 exit

interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 description WAN-PUBLIC-UPLINK
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
 exit

! --- HARDENED ROUTING ENGINE PROTOCOL ---
router ospf 1
 router-id 172.16.0.1
 log-adjacency-changes
 network 172.16.0.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 172.16.1.0 0.0.0.127 area 0
 network 172.16.1.128 0.0.0.127 area 0
 network 172.16.2.0 0.0.0.31 area 0
 network 172.16.2.32 0.0.0.31 area 0
 exit

! --- ENTERPRISE DEFENSE ACCESS CONTROL LISTS (ACLs) ---
ip access-list extended ACL-ISOLATE-IOT-AND-GUEST
 remark Permit established return sessions
 permit tcp any any established
 remark Permit internal DNS and DHCP
 permit udp any any eq domain
 permit udp any any eq bootps
 permit udp any any eq bootpc
 remark Deny guest and IoT access to internal corporate subnets (RFC 1918)
 deny ip 10.0.0.0 0.255.255.255 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.255
 deny ip 172.16.0.0 0.15.255.255 172.16.199.0 0.0.0.255
 permit ip any any
 exit

end
write memory

executive_rationales: Physical Media Strategy: Deployed OS2 SMF 10GBASE-LR/ER for long-span inter-building and MAN runs (zero modal dispersion). All link selections strictly adhere to IEEE 802.3 attenuation and transceiver optical budgets.

Layer 2 Resiliency: Enforced IEEE 802.1w Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol (Rapid PVST+). Provides sub-second failure recovery (<1s) via edge port fast transitions and direct proposal-agreement handshakes, eliminating legacy 802.1D 30-50s listening/learning delays.

Subnetting & Addressing: Implemented descending bitwise VLSM allocation within 172.16.0.0/12. Allocated 5 non-overlapping subnets (576 total addresses reserved, 450 active hosts) achieving 78.1% address space efficiency. All wildcard masks derived via bitwise unsigned negation.

Routing Architecture: OSPF Area 0 with Dual-Homed Fast Convergence. Selected OSPF Area 0 with aggressive link-state timers and BFD integration. For a high-frequency FinTech and Metro MAN topology with 5 subnets, single-area OSPF provides deterministic sub-5ms failover without inter-area summarization overhead. (Reference: IETF RFC 2328 (OSPFv2) & RFC 5880 (BFD)).
